title: Implement gmind plan document sync
description: Bidirectional sync between Plan.md and Beads Issues. Parse YAML markers. Show plan progress summary. Bootstrap plans from PRD. Use spike-plan-document-format.md. Related to PRD-03 Section 1.
close_reason: Implemented gmind plan sync, status, and create subcommands. Added bidirectional sync between Markdown and Beads, progress summary, and PRD bootstrapping.

title: Implement gmind github shell wrapper
description: We will implement the subcommands in cli/gmind/cmd/github.go. We will use os/exec to natively call git and gh CLI. github commits will run 'git log --all --grep=Beads-ID: <id>'. github prs will run 'gh pr list --search <id> --state all'. github ci will run 'gh run list' and filter by <id>. github info will sequentially call the logic of commits, prs, and ci.

title: Implement gmind trace 3-layer tree
description: Trace 3-layer graph: PRD Section <-> Plan Element <-> Task <-> Commit. Flags: --reverse, --include-github, --no-cache, --json. Related to PRD-03 Section 1.
close_reason: Implemented gmind trace 3-layer tree with support for docs parsing, beads labels, and git commits tracing.
